scope: Artistic applicability of blood and elemental impact effects, following the discussion of blood for fire and cold spells.

rules.physical_wounds: Blood on flesh targets for melee, bullets and harpoons.
rules.occult: Blood when the power tears flesh or drains life.
rules.physical_and_elemental: Physical blood and elemental effects may be combined on flesh targets.

rendering_review: New or modified visual renderings remain subject to numbered animated batch review before integration.
gameplay: No automatic Bleeding status or new combat mechanic introduced by this artistic policy.
